data.title: You have been Hacked !
data.statement:
Hackers carry out Advanced Persistent Threat <<cyber attacks>> against a <<number of companies>>.
Each company has a <<firewall>> with a certain configuration's level   which gives this firewall a certain <<protection's degree>>.

Hackers execute 3 types of attack in the following order:
1 - Port scanning <<(ps)>>;
2 - Brute force <<(bf)>>;
3 - Malware installation  <<(mi)>>.

<<each step depends on the success of the previous step>>.

In addition, you should know that each cyberattack has a certain <<level of strengths>>.

The conditions that the cyber attack will be successful or not are:
1 - If the firewall's protection strengths is greater than or equal to <<7>> and cyber attack's strengths of type <<port scanning>> is strictly less than <<10000>>, the firewall will be able to detect the port scanning's attack and it will <<block it>>, otherwise the cyberattack will be successful and the hacker goes to the next step. this type of firewall <<blocks>> other attacks regardless of their strength.

2 - If the firewall's protection strengths is between  <<5 and 6>> and cyber attack's strengths of type <<brute force>> is strictly less than <<5000>>,  the firewall will be able to detect the brute force's attack and it will <<block it>>, otherwise the cyberattack will be successful and the hacker goes to the next step. <<this type of firewall doesn't detect port scanning>> and <<block>> installation malware's attack if the strength of this attack is less than <<3000>>.

3 - If the firewall's protection strengths is strictly less than <<5>> and cyber attack's strengths of type <<Malware installation>> is strictly less than <<1000>>,  the firewall will be able to detect the attempting to send malware and it will <<block>> it, otherwise the cyberattack will be successful and the hackers have full control of the company's information system. this type of firewall doesn't detect port scanning and <<block>> brute force's  attack if the strength of this attack is less than <<500>>.

<<Note:>> Cyberattack strengths of the same type against the same company are <<cumulative>>. You must <<sum>> their strengths before evaluating if the attack succeeds or is blocked.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Hackers carry out Advanced Persistent Threat cyber attacks against a number of companies.
Each company has a firewall with a certain configuration's level which gives this firewall a certain protection's degree.

Hackers execute 3 types of attack in the following order:
1 - Port scanning (ps);
2 - Brute force (bf);
3 - Malware installation (mi).

each step depends on the success of the previous step.

In addition, you should know that each cyberattack has a certain level of strengths.

The conditions that the cyber attack will be successful or not are:
1 - If the firewall's protection strengths is greater than or equal to 7 and cyber attack's strengths of type port scanning is strictly less than 10000, the firewall will be able to detect the port scanning's attack and it will block it, otherwise the cyberattack will be successful and the hacker goes to the next step. this type of firewall blocks other attacks regardless of their strength.

2 - If the firewall's protection strengths is between 5 and 6 and cyber attack's strengths of type brute force is strictly less than 5000, the firewall will be able to detect the brute force's attack and it will block it, otherwise the cyberattack will be successful and the hacker goes to the next step. this type of firewall doesn't detect port scanning and block installation malware's attack if the strength of this attack is less than 3000.

3 - If the firewall's protection strengths is strictly less than 5 and cyber attack's strengths of type Malware installation is strictly less than 1000, the firewall will be able to detect the attempting to send malware and it will block it, otherwise the cyberattack will be successful and the hackers have full control of the company's information system. this type of firewall doesn't detect port scanning and block brute force's attack if the strength of this attack is less than 500.

Note: Cyberattack strengths of the same type against the same company are cumulative. You must sum their strengths before evaluating if the attack succeeds or is blocked.
Input
Line 1: n, the number of companies
Next n Lines: the company's name and firewall's strengths
Line 2: a, the number of cyber attack attempts
Next a Lines: the company's name and attack's type and attack's strengths.
Output
n lines containing the name of company and status of the cyber attack in the same order as the input .
"Company:Hacked" or "Company:Blocked"
Constraints
1 <= n <= 100
1 <= a <= 5000
Example
Input
1
Gold star:5
4
Gold star:ps:1000
Gold star:ps:9001
Gold star:bf:5010
Gold star:mi:3020
Output
Gold star:Hacked
